_comment: Default alert catalogue. Edit, commit to Git, and the collector hot-reloads this file (no restart). Types: event_count | metric_threshold | heartbeat_missing | new_error. 'levels' lets one rule escalate warning -> critical in place. Tune every threshold to your own baseline before go-live.

rules.name: Server not reporting
rules.description: The agent has missed its heartbeats: host down, agent stopped, or network path to the collector broken.

rules.name: Error burst
rules.title: {count} errors in {window_min} min on {server}
rules.description: Volume of ERROR/FATAL events per server in a 5-minute window.

rules.name: Fatal event
rules.title: FATAL on {server}: {sample}
rules.description: Any event logged at the highest severity (Integration Server level C). Access-denied lines are logged at this level too, so they are excluded here and handled by WM-006.

rules.name: JVM out of memory

match.message: OutOfMemoryError|Java heap space|GC overhead limit exceeded|unable to create (new )?native thread

rules.title: JVM memory exhaustion on {server}
rules.description: Heap or thread exhaustion. Usually needs a restart and a heap/thread dump.

rules.name: Database connectivity
rules.title: Database/JDBC connection problems on {server} ({count} in {window_min} min)
rules.description: Connection refused, pool exhaustion or login failures against a JDBC resource.

rules.name: Authentication failures
rules.title: {count} authentication failures across the fleet in {window_min} min
rules.description: Possible credential stuffing, a misconfigured client, or an expired service password.

rules.name: New error pattern
rules.description: An error whose fingerprint has never been seen anywhere in the fleet. Typical after a deployment.

rules.name: Disk space
rules.title: Disk {label} at {value}% on {server}
rules.description: Used space on a monitored file system other than /opt* (the /var* volumes, the NAS mounts /wMNfs and /wMShared, anything else in the agent's disk_mounts / disk_paths). Healthy is under 75%; 90% and above is critical. A NAS share listed under shared_storage in the server list alerts once, not once per server. /opt* has per-landscape limits in WM-019..WM-021.

rules.name: Mount point missing
rules.title: Mount point {label} is not mounted on {server}
rules.description: A monitored file system (agent disk_mounts) is not in the host's mount table: an NFS share (/wMNfs, /wMShared) that did not mount or dropped, or a local volume that is missing. Integration Server writes into these paths, so expect failures until it is mounted again.

rules.name: Disk space /opt (Dev)
rules.title: Disk {label} at {value}% on {server}
rules.description: Used space on the /opt* file systems of Dev (CON and CN1) servers. Healthy is under 90%; 95% and above is critical. Scope matches the landscape in the server list or the environment the agent reports.

rules.name: Disk space /opt (UAT)
rules.title: Disk {label} at {value}% on {server}
rules.description: Used space on the /opt* file systems of UAT (Test and PSS) servers. Healthy is under 85%; 95% and above is critical. Scope matches the landscape in the server list or the environment the agent reports.

rules.name: Disk space /opt (Prod, DR and others)
rules.title: Disk {label} at {value}% on {server}
rules.description: Used space on the /opt* file systems of PROD and DR servers. Healthy is under 75%; 90% and above is critical. Applies to every landscape not covered by WM-019 / WM-020 (so a new landscape gets the strictest limit). Scope matches the landscape in the server list or the environment the agent reports.

rules.name: Health probe failing
rules.title: Probe "{label}" failing on {server}
rules.description: The agent's local HTTP/TCP probe (for example Integration Server ping) is failing while the host is alive.

rules.name: Probe slow
rules.title: Probe "{label}" slow on {server}: {value} ms
rules.description: Response time of the local probe has stayed above 2 s for five minutes.

rules.name: Log file silent
rules.title: {label} has not been written for {value} s on {server}
rules.description: No new lines in server.log for 30 minutes. Tune or scope this for quiet environments.

rules.name: High CPU load
rules.title: Load per CPU {value} on {server}
rules.description: 1-minute load average divided by CPU count, sustained for five minutes.

rules.name: Host memory
rules.title: Host memory at {value}% on {server}
rules.description: Operating-system memory in use, sustained for five minutes.

rules.name: Agent delivery backlog
rules.title: Agent on {server} has {value} undelivered batches
rules.description: The agent is reachable but is not draining its local spool fast enough.

rules.name: Agent dropped events
rules.title: Agent on {server} dropped {value} events (spool cap reached)
rules.description: The local spool hit its size cap during an outage and the oldest events were discarded.

rules.name: Clock skew
rules.title: Clock on {server} differs from the collector by {value} s
rules.description: Timestamps from this host are unreliable until NTP is fixed.

rules.name: Agent quarantined batches
rules.title: Agent on {server} has {value} rejected batch(es) in its quarantine folder
rules.description: The collector refused these batches as malformed or too large (HTTP 400/413/415/422). Their events are not stored. Inspect <spool_dir>/rejected on the host, then remove the files to clear the alert.
